chapter.verse: Topa aw, nang kong sam hi; hong kinawh in! Nang kong sap ciangin ka aw hong ngai in!
Ka thungetna pen nangma mai-ah paknamtui, ka khutte ka laptohna pen nitak biak piakna bangsak in!
Topa aw, keima kam a cing ding khat koih in la, ka mukte’ kongkhak a vil ding khat koih in!
Mawhna bawl nopna lungsim hong nei sak kei in la, a gilo mite tawh hong kikhawlsak kei in. Amau anlimte hong duhgawh sak kei ta in.
Mi phapa kei hong vuasak in la, ahih hangin migilopa ka lu sathau nilh sak ngei kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ gitloh gamtatnate lang pangin thu ka ngenngen hi.
Amaute, thu kisitin mawhsakna a thuak uh ciangin, Topa ’ thute man hi, ci-in a thei ding uh hi.
Mi khat in suangpi khat sukhamin leitungah a thehthang gawp bangin Leinuai’ kongvang ah amau guhte kithehthang ding hi.
Ahih hangin Topa Pasian aw, nang ka hong muang tawntung a, nangmah ka hong beel hi; kei hong nusia kei in!
Amaute in keimah hong siahna uh tehlop leh siatna bawlte’ thangzak panin kei hong kem in!
Kei ka suahtak ciangin amau’ ngenthang sung mah-ah migilote awk sak in.
